init.title: General settings (1/2 with TCP enabled)
init.description:
Configure update intervals and charging preferences.

**With native TCP enabled, configuration has two pages.** Confirm this page to continue to step 2: TCP connection and automatic cloud fallback. Changes are saved only after you confirm the second page. Closing the dialog before then discards the pending changes.

**With native TCP disabled, confirming this page saves the settings immediately; there is no second page.**

data.remember_charge_mode: Restore the mode selected in HA before charging

data_description.scan_interval: Normal cloud/Modbus polling interval when idle. Local TCP uses 5 seconds, or 2 seconds while power protection is active. Verified MQTT telemetry can temporarily double the backup HTTP interval; control actions can request an earlier update.
data_description.scan_interval_charging: Normal cloud/Modbus polling interval while charging. Local TCP uses its own 2/5-second safety polling. Verified MQTT telemetry can temporarily double the backup HTTP interval.
data_description.plant_id: Shows the known or manually overridden value. You can edit it; leave empty to use automatic detection.
data_description.product_model: Shows the known or manually overridden value. You can edit it; leave empty to use automatic detection.
data_description.remember_charge_mode: When you enable this option, the currently reported wallbox mode becomes the saved preference; if it cannot be read, the change is not saved. Afterwards, each Start from HA restores and verifies the saved mode. Selecting a mode in HA updates this preference. SolarGo changes do not replace it. The preference survives reloads/restarts. Disabled: keep the current wallbox mode. No mode is forced at startup or periodically. TCP power protection remains active independently.
data_description.native_enabled: Enabled: continue to the TCP and automatic fallback settings on page 2. Disabled: save on this page.

native.title: TCP and automatic fallback (2/2)
native.description:
**Step 2 of 2.** Review the TCP connection and automatic fallback settings below. Confirm this page to save changes from both pages.

Development: configure a reachable LAN listener. Setup does not redirect the wallbox. Use Local TCP connection to switch Socket A; switching it off or unloading restores the original cloud endpoint. Power is selectable in 0.1 kW steps within the identified model range. Native mode keeps HA charging preferences. A TCP-only entry has no cloud telemetry.

Without a saved power limit, the integration uses the model minimum (4.2 kW for GW11 HCA). Change the limit using the charging-power entity; saved limits survive reloads and restarts.

data.native_advertised_host: Home Assistant IPv4 address reachable from the wallbox
data.native_ingress_peer: Trusted TCP proxy IPv4 (optional; for Docker source NAT only)
data.native_auto_fallback: Automatically use TCP when cloud fails

data_description.native_auto_fallback: Requires a cloud account. Automatic takeover requires at least three failures and 90 seconds from the first detected failure. A return trial is attempted after 30 minutes when idle and after a successful preliminary check; fresh cloud data must arrive within 60 seconds. Failed trials increase the delay up to two hours. Manual TCP stays selected across reloads and pauses automatic return until you select cloud. Selecting cloud manually pauses automatic fallback until reload.
